description: Returns undated facts for one identified Brek property ID, including address, description, photos, amenities, check-in and checkout times, star rating, and guest-review data. When the user refers to a hotel from a previous search_accommodations result by full or partial name or list position, copy that result's propertyId exactly if the match is unique; never shorten, combine, or use a placeholder ID. Ask for clarification if several hotels match. If no exact property ID is available, hotelName and optional destination can identify a unique hotel. No stay dates are needed. Availability, room offers, prices, breakfast, and cancellation terms are not included.

currency.description: Only specify a currency when the traveler explicitly requests one. Otherwise omit it so Brek can use the visitor country, then locale, then USD. Supported: EUR, USD, INR, GBP, AUD, CAD, ARS, TRY, COP, CLP, SEK, MXN, IDR, BRL.

destination.description: Optional city or region to disambiguate hotelName.

hotelName.description: Hotel name when no propertyId is available; a unique match is required.

propertyId.description: Exact Brek property ID copied from a previous search result. Do not guess, truncate, combine, or pass a placeholder; use hotelName if unsure.

name: get_accommodation_details
title: Get undated hotel facts
